title: 他不能告诉我 · He Can’t Tell Me
description: 下课吃午饭时，阿登问了一个很简单的问题。听见他的回答，两个朋友都停了下来。

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied EPUB: conclusion of SIX: Gorgon including the final reply; SEVEN: A Little Delusional through Boe saying he too wants to try feeding Gorgon. Mandarin adaptation; all theories stay explicitly unconfirmed.

planning.sourceBoundary: SIX: Icy wind swept through the lobby → final reply; SEVEN: opening of history class through Boe’s offer at lunch, before Alden answers Right? I spent the whole class...
planning.voiceReason: Social embarrassment becomes private amateur detective work; Alden checks his own reasoning and the cost of his guesses.
planning.dramaticChange: Gorgon publicly reads attraction but cannot say what he wants to eat. Alden brings the puzzle to his friends; Boe starts to share the curiosity.
planning.desire: Find one affordable, useful food experiment.
planning.obstacle: Gorgon cannot give even a yes/no answer about food.
planning.earlyCare: Alden objects to discussing classmates’ private feelings.
planning.payoff: Alden decides to try cheaper foods first and gains an interested ally.
planning.newUncertainty: What affordable food can they actually test? Neither the diet nor the restriction is solved.
planning.englishNarrationPurpose: None. Mandarin story and choices throughout.
choicesAndCallbacks: Notice mirror or monitor: embarrassment versus Gorgon’s indifference.
List affordable food or frame the question: possible experiment versus cause.
Question live prey or compare costs: doubt versus savings.
Lead with refused foods or Gorgon’s correction: evidence versus first-person account. Local branches rejoin; no new lasting variables.
sceneActivities: Lobby two-shot; seated Alden in the history class making lists; return to friends at the shop counter. Shoes, writing and lunch actions narrated.
planning.directing: Shared lunch discussion → Alden says he cannot tell me → Boe surprised listener and held pause → pair returns for explanation.

signatures.Gorgon: Dry literal refusal to respect human discretion; existing seated static art.
signatures.Alden: Awkward social recoil, cautious hypotheses, pragmatic cost test.
signatures.Boe: Dry cheap-food suggestion becomes an earnest question.

planning.pinyinReview: Reviewed 45 sentences and their chunk readings; corrected dei for obligation, zhi for only, experiential guo and neutral tones.

continuation.end: After Gorgon’s embarrassing assessment of classmates, Alden spends history class listing affordable food tests. At lunch he explains Gorgon cannot request food or answer a question about insects; Boe now wants to try feeding him too.
continuation.note: Resume mid-lunch with Alden agreeing. Continue through the guesses, crickets, separation for afternoon classes and wordchaining introspection. Stop before the deeper reflection on Hannah.
continuity: Alden proposes testing affordable foods first. Live insects are a theory only.
Boe is curious and wants to help; no food experiment has yet happened.
Gorgon cannot request food. His reasons and the reason for the restrictions remain unknown.
